simple.meaning: שֶׁמֶשׁ (shemesh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the sun ; by implication, the east ; figuratively, a ray , i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 134 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 15:12. Its contexts include family, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁמֶשׁ (H8121).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֶׁמֶשׁ (shemesh) / H8121 is traced through Genesis 15:12, Genesis 15:17, Genesis 19:23, Genesis 28:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H8121. shemesh שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ 133 noun feminine Judg 19:14 and masculine Gen 19:23 (Albr ZAW xv (1895), 324 ) sun ; — absolute ׳שׁ Josh 10:12 +, שָׁ֑מֶשׁ Judg 20:43 +; suffix שִׁמְשֵׁךְ Isa 60:20 , שִׁמְשָׁךְ Jer 15:9 ; plural suffix שִׁמְשֹׁתַ֫יִךְ Isa 54:12 ; — 1 sun , Gen 37:9 (E; + moon, stars); marking time: as rising (verb זָרַת q. v.) Exod 22:2 (E) + 8 t. + Malachi 3:20 (figurative ׳שׁ צְדָקָה , of reward of the faithful, with wings, i.e. rays ? Now GASm; or winged sun-disc [compare We] ?); verb יְצָא Gen 19:23 (J), Isa 13:10 ; Judg 5:31 (simile of splendour; see יְצָא 1f ); setting (verb בּוֺא ) Gen 15:17 (J), Amos 8:9 19t., + הַשּׁ ׳וַיְהִי לָבוֺא Gen 15:12 (JE), ׳שׁ מְבוֺאוֺ יְדַע Psa 104:19 (see בּוֺא 1i , מָבוֺא 2 ); as giving daylight Isa 60:9 ; hot 1Sam 11:9 ; Neh 7:3 ; Exod 16:21 (P), compare Isa 49:10 ; Jonah 4:8 ; Psa 121:6 ; as ripening crops Deut 33:14 (poem), compare (figurative) Job 8:16 , tanning the face Song 1:6 ; standing still at Joshua's word Josh 10:12 .13 a (poem in J; || יָרֵחַ ), 10:13 b (J), compare Hab 3:11 (+ יָרֵךְַ ); casting shadow (on dial), בַּשּׁ אָחָז בְמַעֲלוֺת ׳יָָֽרְדָה Isa 38:8 , הַשּׁ ׳וַתָּשָׁב 38:8 ; set in sky by ׳י Jer 31:25 ; Psa 19:5 ; 74:16 ; 136:8 , enduring 72:5 ; 72:17 (compare עִם 1g ; [ מָּנֶה ] 11. 4 a ( e ), p. 817), also Psa 89:37 ; personified, called to praise ׳י 148:3 (+ יָרֵךְַ ); to be darkened by ׳י s judgment, Ezek 32:7 ; Joel 2:10 ; 3:4 ; Joel 4:15 (compare Amos 8:9 above, Micah 3:6 ). 2 of direction: הַשּׁ ׳מִמִּוְרַח Num 21:11 (E) toward sun-rise, = East , compare Deut 4:41 , 47 16 t. (see מִוְרָךְ p. 280); הַשּׁ ׳מְבוֺא 11:30 3 t. (see מָבוֺא 2 , p. 99). 3 object of worship (usually + moon, stars, etc.) 2Kin 23:5 ; Jer 8:2 ; Ezek 8:16 ; Deut 4:19 ; horses given to ׳שׁ 2Kin 23:11 , השּׁ ׳מַרְכְּבוֺת 23:11 . — See also שׁ ׳בֵּית p. 112:b. 4 other phrase: a. חַשּׁ ׳נֶגֶד , i.e. openly, publicly , 2Sam 12:12 ; Num 25:4 (P), so חַשּׁ ׳לְעֵינֵי 2Sam 12:11 . b. figurative of living , שׁ ׳חָזָה Psa 58:9 , שׁ ׳רָאָה Exod 6:5 ; 7:11 ; 11:7 , opposed to הַשׁ ׳תֶּחְשַׁךְ 12:2 . c. הַשּׁ ׳תַּחַת , i. e. on the earth, Eccl 1:3 28t. Ecclesiastes (compare Greek ὐφ’ ἠλίῳ , Kue Ond. iii. 196 ; Ein1. iii. 192). 5 pinnacle , as glittering, shining , plural Isa 54:12 thy pinnacles, battlements (of Zion), so perhaps singular ׳שׁ י ׳וּמָנֵן אֱםהִים Psa 84:12 battlement and shield is ׳י ׳א (Gr Bae Du Buhl; most sun , and so Thes De Che SS; Hup-Now hesitates).
